title: What deployment strategies do you use and when?
description: Compare blue-green, canary, rolling, and feature flag deployments.

data.text: Question: What deployment strategies do you use and when?
Blue-green for zero-d downtime, canary for gradual rollout, rolling for stateless services, and feature flags for decoupling deploy from release.

items: Blue-green: two identical environments, switch traffic
Canary: route a small percentage of traffic to new version
Rolling: update instances one by one
Feature flags: toggle features without redeploying
Dark launching: run new code in parallel without user impact
How do you handle database migrations in CI/CD?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Match strategy to risk and user base
data.takeaway: Match strategy to risk and user base
